# Pokémon Unbound auf Deutsch (German Fan-Translation)

> A community-driven German (Deutsch) localization of Pokémon Unbound, a Pokémon FireRed ROM hack built on the CFRU ecosystem. This repository is documentation, terminology, and human-QA coordination for the translation. Public beta since 2026-10-08 (Beta v0.1.4 on 2026-10-17 at the time of writing); the latest version is always at https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/releases/latest – patch-only `.bps` download (no ROM, no patched ROM; bring your own legal base ROM), or patch in the browser at https://pokemon-unbound-de.github.io/pokemon-unbound-de/

Main maintainer and point of contact: Nevio · Official Repository: https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de

Key facts:
- Language: German (Deutsch) localization of an English ROM hack.
- Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem.
- Status: Public Beta since 2026-10-08 (v0.1.7.3 on 2026-10-31 at the time of writing; latest: https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/releases/latest). Next: stable 1.0 after the test phase. AI-assisted and machine-checked; human proofreading ongoing.
- Distribution policy: patch-only, no ROMs or commercial assets are hosted or shared.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders; unofficial fan project.

## FAQ

- **Is there a download or patch? / Gibt es einen Download?** Yes – easiest via the browser patch page (https://pokemon-unbound-de.github.io/pokemon-unbound-de/, FireRed USA Rev 0), or as a `.bps` patch on the latest release page (https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/releases/latest). Base ROM: Pokémon FireRed (USA) Rev 0 or Pokémon Unbound (EN) v1.0.1; no ROMs are hosted. Guide: docs/PATCH_ANLEITUNG.md
- **Which version is supported? / Welche Version?** Likely based on **Pokémon Unbound v1.0.1** (per the in-ROM copyright-splash graphic, 2016–2020 Skeli Games) — not the current final version v2.1.1.1 (since November 2022). Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem; the patch targets defined base ROMs with published MD5 checksums (MD5.txt on the release page). A port to Unbound 2.1.1.1 gets a preview in late October 2026; its beta follows after the stable release of the 1.0.1 line.
- **How can I help? / Wie kann ich helfen?** Human QA is the priority — screenshot QA, terminology/lore, natural German wording, and rendering/textbox checks. See the open Issues and Discussions below.
- **Is this legal? / Ist das legal?** Unofficial fan translation, not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders. No ROMs, BIOS files, save states, or commercial assets are distributed.

## How to contribute

- [Open Issues](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/issues): screenshot QA, terminology/lore, rendering QA, release policy.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/discussions): questions, wording feedback, and general project discussion.
